subject: English
question_text: Fill in each gap with suitable words based on the information of the text. 1 5 =
stimulus: Pahela Boishakh, the first day of the Bangla new year, is celebrated with great (a) ------- across Bangladesh. People wear traditional clothes, enjoy cultural programmes, and eat traditional food. The most colourful celebration takes place at Ramna Batamul in Dhaka, where artists perform (b) ------- songs and dances. A major highlight of the day is the vibrant (c) ------- organised by the students of Fine Arts at Dhaka University. People wear masks and carry symbols that reflect both joy and (d) ------- in national life. The celebration spreads across the country, uniting people regardless of caste or (e) -------. ■■■ ■■■
guide_solution: Ans. (a) enthusiasm; (b) folk; (c) procession; (d) concerns; (e) creed;
